headline: Frequent Rework of Loop Functions
diagnosis: The loop functions in _loop.py are repeatedly modified, primarily due to issues related to performance and functionality, as indicated by commit messages like 'optimization' and 'Fix list view flicker'. The recurring theme suggests that the implementations are not meeting the expected behavior, particularly in how they handle edge cases and performance under different conditions.
plan: Conduct a thorough review of the loop functions to identify performance bottlenecks and edge case failures, especially in loop_from_index.
Implement comprehensive unit tests for all loop functions, focusing on boundary conditions and performance metrics to ensure they meet requirements.
Engage with the author for a collaborative review session to discuss the identified issues and gather insights on the intended functionality versus actual behavior.
Establish a code review checklist specifically for the loop functions to prevent future regressions and ensure adherence to performance standards.
owner_hint: The sole author is responsible for the ongoing maintenance and improvement of this file.
